purpose: Identify research capable of testing when experiences of interconnection become durable compassionate action, just institutions and ecological flourishing.

priorities.title: Compassion at scale
priorities.question: Which practices reliably convert empathy, compassion or metta into sustained helping, generosity and nonviolence?

priorities.title: States into traits into service
priorities.question: When do psychedelic, contemplative, mystical or collective experiences produce lasting humility, care and ethical action?

priorities.title: Flexible selfhood and prejudice
priorities.question: Does safely loosening rigid self-models reduce dehumanisation, prejudice and tribal hostility?

priorities.title: Ecological connectedness
priorities.question: Does felt connection with nature predict or cause measurable stewardship and lower-impact behaviour?

priorities.title: Collective synchrony without metaphysical assumptions
priorities.question: How do music, dance, ritual and shared attention affect trust, cooperation and belonging?

priorities.title: Trauma and intergenerational repair
priorities.question: Which combinations of therapy, embodiment, community and meaning-making interrupt cycles of harm safely?

priorities.title: Death awareness and compassionate priorities
priorities.question: Can death contemplation or end-of-life engagement reduce fear and increase care without requiring survival beliefs?

priorities.title: Wisdom across cultures
priorities.question: Which ethical insights recur across traditions, and which meanings must remain culturally and lineage specific?

priorities.title: Community care and mutual witnessing
priorities.question: Which forms of listening and moderated experience-sharing improve belonging without amplifying dogma, delusion or misinformation?

priorities.title: Attention and information ecology
priorities.question: How do platforms, algorithms and AI alter agency, empathy and collective reality formation?

priorities.title: Institutions of care
priorities.question: Which organisational, educational and economic structures reward cooperation, sufficiency and stewardship rather than extraction?

priorities.title: Measuring flourishing
priorities.question: Which indicators capture meaning, belonging, compassion, justice and ecological health beyond narrow economic output?

methodological_requirements: Prospective and longitudinal designs where feasible.
Behavioural, third-party, institutional or ecological measures alongside self-report.
Null results, adverse effects and heterogeneous responses retained.
Selection, expectancy, demand-characteristic and social-desirability alternatives assessed.
No metaphysical conclusion inferred from psychological or social outcomes.
Community-led cultural governance, permission and benefit sharing where applicable.
No individual-level change presented as institutional or planetary change without direct measurement.

community_role.n2n_function: Generate questions, lived-experience signals, counterexamples and candidate patterns for formal review.
community_role.evidence_boundary: Community recurrence and testimony can motivate research but cannot establish causation, efficacy or universal truth.
community_role.consent_boundary: Do not extract personal narratives, cultural material or identifying information without permission.
